tbesh_html:
1) to have power, rule, domineer, rule over
1a) (P'al) have power upon or over, rule, fall upon, assault, be ruler
1b) (Aphel) make ruler

strongs_1890.strongs_def: {to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit}
strongs_1890.kjv_def: have the mastery, have power, bear rule, be (make) ruler.
